blogs.title: Getting Started with React
blogs.author: Riya Shah
blogs.description: A quick intro to React for beginners.
blogs.content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Learn components, props and state, and you can build almost any front end.

blogs.title: Healthy Habits for Students
blogs.author: Amit Patel
blogs.content: Sleep, exercise and planning make a big difference to how well you study. Start small and build one habit at a time.

blogs.title: Budget Travel Tips for Beginners
blogs.author: Neha Verma
blogs.description: Plan a memorable trip without overspending.
blogs.content: Book early, travel off-season and use local transport. Small choices like these can cut the cost of a trip by almost half.

blogs.title: Street-Style Pav Bhaji at Home
blogs.author: Kunal Mehta
blogs.description: Recreate the famous street food in your own kitchen.
blogs.content: Mash boiled vegetables with butter and pav bhaji masala, simmer until thick, and serve with toasted buttered pav and a squeeze of lemon.

blogs.title: Redux Toolkit in 30 Minutes
blogs.author: Riya Shah
blogs.description: Learn slices, thunks and the store the easy way.
blogs.content: Redux Toolkit removes most of the boilerplate. Create a slice, add async thunks for API calls and connect the store with a Provider.

blogs.title: Build a Study Routine That Sticks
blogs.author: Pooja Desai
blogs.description: Practical ways to stay consistent with your studies.
blogs.content: Set fixed study hours, work in 25-minute focus blocks and review notes the same day. Consistency beats long, occasional sessions.

blogs.title: Five-Minute Stretches for Desk Workers
blogs.author: Dr. Sanjay Rao
blogs.description: Quick stretches to ease neck and back stiffness.
blogs.content: Roll your shoulders, stretch your neck gently and stand to reach overhead every hour. Short breaks keep your body relaxed through the day.

blogs.title: Minimalist Living: Declutter Your Space
blogs.author: Neha Verma
blogs.description: Simple steps to a calmer, tidier home.
blogs.content: Start with one drawer, keep only what you use and give away the rest. A tidy space makes it easier to focus and relax.

blogs.title: Exploring the Mountain Trails of Himachal
blogs.author: Kunal Mehta
blogs.description: A trekker's guide to scenic Himalayan trails.
blogs.content: Pack light, carry water and start early. The trails reward you with pine forests, snow views and quiet villages along the way.
